# 🏛️ CLOCKEE VERCEL DEPLOYMENT ARCHITECTURE & STRATEGY

Deploying ClockEE to Vercel is an excellent move for instant global edge delivery, sub-second load times for CBT tests, and zero server maintenance. 

To make this seamless, we need to address the key architectural transition: **Moving from local disk SQLite (`clockee.db`) to serverless cloud infrastructure.**

---
